reviewer_instructions: Each case is independent. Present its unchanged prompt together with its fixture_input; do not treat missing information as an invitation to invent facts.
All scenario facts are newly authored synthetic premises, not observations about a real patient, employee, organisation, policy or event. Relative times are fictional and have no calendar anchor.
Source IDs refer only to text included in that case. Do not fetch external evidence, use historical real-case files or reuse private study evidence.
Review against the listed expectations without assuming an observed output, successful trigger, runtime compatibility or professional validation.

Fictional acceptance inside a scenario is only an exercise premise. Agent-panel review of this packet is not clinical, legal, policy, regulatory, cultural-safety, employment, organisational or deployment approval.
